superseded_note: Retained for provenance, but the medians below are load-contaminated: these runs were taken while several unrelated heavy compile jobs were running on this machine. Re-running the byte-identical binary on an idle machine raised throughput by roughly 75% (median 1203.78 -> 2138.72 req/s). The socket_pressure_finding below is still valid and carried forward. See the v4 artifact.
supersedes_note: Same measurement date as the artifact it supersedes, so the filenames are distinguished by the `-remeasured` suffix rather than by date. This is an independent re-run of the byte-identical workload, not a later-day repeat.

distribution_across_12_runs.note: Independent re-measurement. Only runs taken under low socket pressure (fewer than ~5,000 TIME_WAIT entries at start) and with zero errors are included; see socket_pressure_finding.

comparison_with_v2.note: The v2 artifact's throughput and p95 reproduce; p50 and p99 do not, and v2's envelopes were too narrow.
comparison_with_v2.throughput_requests_per_second: reproduces (v2 median 1191.05 vs 1203.78; each median sits inside the other's range)
comparison_with_v2.p50_us: does NOT reproduce (v2 median 6834, range 5928-8711; re-measured median 8859, range 6311-10946). v2's max is below this median, so v2's p50 range was too narrow.
comparison_with_v2.p99_us: does NOT reproduce (v2 median 103562, range 63075-141834; re-measured median 74590, range 33165-155351). v2's stated minimum is above this sample's median, so v2 overstated the tail.

socket_pressure_finding.note: New finding from this re-measurement, extending the v2 ephemeral-port note. Throughput degrades monotonically as TIME_WAIT accumulates, well BEFORE any connection errors appear, so a port-starved run silently reports a low number rather than failing.
socket_pressure_finding.observed: With TIME_WAIT above ~10,000, throughput fell to 244-400 req/s and p99 rose past 350 ms, with 0-17 errors. Runs starting below ~5,000 TIME_WAIT stayed in the 940-1,660 req/s band.
socket_pressure_finding.implication: 20s spacing between runs is insufficient on this machine; TIME_WAIT continued rising across a 180s pause. Entries then age out in bulk. Runs must be filtered on starting socket pressure, not just on the absence of errors.

measurement_caveats: Power-managed laptop with unpinned CPU clocks; figures are envelopes, not point claims. A quiesced machine would tighten them.
Loopback TCP/HTTP with one connection per request. Release compilation excluded.
No GPU, ONNX Runtime, or PyTorch execution was measured. Not a capacity or service-level claim.
